# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-09 from the 2026-11-09 Hub dump.

- 3,223,298 models tracked, 923,838 declare a base model, 957,119 parent links, 91,492 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
